name: TT-Metal / TT-NN GitHub repository
notes: tt-metal README: TT-NN is the Python & C++ neural-network operator library and TT-Metalium the low-level kernel programming model for Tenstorrent silicon. Carries Tenstorrent's own LLM throughput tables per hardware config (Galaxy/Wormhole, n300, QuietBox, n150, p150 Blackhole) with TTFT and T/S/U at batch 32 and batch 1. The README's own caveat is the important part: metrics come from the tt-metal model demos and 'Results may vary when using other runtimes such as the vLLM inference server', with a separate vLLM-TT-plugin release column.
